name: Passkey Step-Up Success
summary: Deprecated mechanism-specific step-up behavior retained for historical references; canonical step-up requirements are now modeled independently of the MFA mechanism used to satisfy them.
finalOutcome: Use auth.behavior.step-up-security.success for the canonical user-facing behavior. Passkey proof may remain one supported mechanism for satisfying that behavior.

sourceReferences.note: Step-up security is a mechanism-independent MFA requirement; passkey is one possible proof mechanism.
